lookahead_selection: Historical gap0 third-turn main runtime sometimes 10.3-14.0s, less than 13.4-15.8s summary time. One turn lead may leave residual waits; reserve two turns before sampling both new groups.
stop_rule: Stop each conversation on runtime error or pending owner input; retain every attempt, no replacement successes.
grading: Strict production summary/schema/source validation; target near-zero load waits and zero synchronous summaries. Returned turns are completion counts, not task-quality successes.
measurement: run_turn wall excludes reading gaps. Keep requested and measured gap durations separately. Count load waits, load/commit synchronous summaries, background calls and failures with individual durations. Both groups run serially with no simultaneous online evals.
baseline: evals/summary_incremental/load_wait_2026-10-09/latency.json; old unconditional waiting and no row headroom, gap0 only
limits: Authored fixture with directly seeded history; fixed gap20 is an assumption, not estimated from natural traffic. No causal comparison of all runtime wall time to older code/prompt batches. Whole working tree contains pre-existing receipt-delivery edits.
